title: The Dark Forest
author: Cixin Liu
summary: The second book of the Remembrance of Earth's Past trilogy. Humanity knows an alien fleet is coming and has centuries to prepare, and chooses a handful of individuals to devise strategies that must stay secret even from their own side.
readIf: you enjoy huge-concept science fiction that treats first contact as a problem of game theory.
skipIf: you haven't read the first book, or you want strong character work over ideas.

pairings.reason: Another ambitious, idea-heavy science fiction work with a far-future sweep and a structure that rewards patience.
A shorter, calmer take on meeting something vast and incomprehensible from space.
Another large-scale story about how humanity relates to a very different intelligence over generations.
